reports.name: heading-with-preceding-context
reports.transcript: Then I write that you said so. She did. See, the fourth is lighter, not checked. How? She stopped. She knew how. It was the thing that Coombe had made them do, a count allowed and a cut on the and, and somebody kept free to keep the count. She could write that. She could not write who.

note: No production/canon change. Numeric input is a deliberate derived pronunciation audition, not the original word lock. Supervisor review required; ASR is not human listening.
